protected_mask: one union mask of the retained cue regions per image
task: Measure whole-image and protected-region MSE and SSIM; draw utility versus epsilon curves; return per-image raw results.
draw_policy: Use the supplied saved draw 0 for both mechanisms. It is the existing first draw, not a request to regenerate all images from integer seed 0. Draws 1 and 2 are held in reserve and not included.
mechanism_note: epsilon is the saved mechanism parameter; larger values mean weaker perturbation. The exponential mechanism uses the existing finite RGB candidate kernel, not an SSIM objective.
reference_note: Every utility metric compares the saved perturbed view against the matching original; original rows provide the identity check.
access: Public research/teaching repository; original image rights and license conditions remain with their respective owners.
original_metadata: Original file bytes are preserved, including existing embedded metadata. These images are not metadata-sanitized.
